Chapter 391: Chapter 10: The Silent Chikun Star Lord (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 391: Chapter 10: The Silent Chikun Star Lord (Subscription Requested)

The Mental Will Index could reach more than 9200.

It was indeed beyond Lin Yuan’s expectations.

Two or three years ago, when Lin Yuan first measured his Mental Will Index,

it was only 7848.

This Mental Will Index of 7848, was the strength of spirit Lin Yuan had accumulated after experiencing six travels through time and more than a thousand years.

Now, just two or three years had passed, and it had increased by more than a thousand. It was truly inconceivable.

...

As is well known, the higher the Mental Will Index goes, the harder it becomes to increase. Lin Yuan’s worst plan was to experience several more travels.

Using the long duration of world travels to forcibly stack up his Mental Will Index.

However, that would basically waste the chances of travel because, below the Eighth Layer, understanding the rules would only get harder.

In fact, considering Lin Yuan’s current Seventh-Rank status, the ability to understand the core space rule model was already unbelievable.

Normally, only at the Eighth Rank do Evolvers begin to comprehend the core space model.

Moreover, the core space models Lin Yuan had understood already numbered over thirteen hundred, a level many peak Eighth-Rank Evolvers could hardly reach.

“According to this pace, in at most one or two years, my Mental Will Index could reach ten thousand. Then, I can choose any world to traverse and try to undergo the Heart Demon Tribulation…”

Lin Yuan silently thought.

Once the Heart Demon Tribulation was passed, nothing would obstruct Lin Yuan from stepping into the Eighth Rank.

For an Evolver to step into the Eighth Rank, three prerequisites need to be met.

First, a high enough Mental Will Index, ideally reaching ten thousand points.

Second, the creation of an Inner World, only then is the foundation laid for stepping into the Eighth Rank.

Third is to refine the Physical Soul to the absolute peak of perfection of the Seventh Rank.

The third prerequisite is similar to the first, requiring the Evolver to consume a lot of time.

After all, even at the Seventh-Rank King Level Peak, it’s still not considered complete perfection, there are minute details that need to be refined slowly.

That process is very time-consuming.

However, the third prerequisite, for Lin Yuan, was as if it was non-existent.

Once the Inner World is formed, the power of the world permeates his body, nurturing the Physical Soul and even the Mental Will.

More than a year ago, Lin Yuan’s Physical Soul had already achieved absolute perfection of the Seventh Rank without a single flaw.

And with the continuous nourishment of the power of the world, Lin Yuan’s Physical Soul was still slowly improving, pushing the boundaries of the great realm slowly.

This is the power of the world, a unique force for Evolvers of the Eighth Rank, especially since Lin Yuan’s Inner World had reached more than a hundred thousand miles in diameter, further perfected by three universe’s rare treasures.

The resulting power of the world was immensely beneficial to Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan felt that even if he didn’t undergo the Heart Demon Tribulation, just relying on the nourishment of the world’s power alone, he could one day reach the peak of the Eighth Rank, the ultimate Eighth Rank.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan was seated cross-legged at the mountain peak.

“Quite a few people have been replaced.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the other mountain tops. Over these two or three years, many Evolvers, due to practicing the Evolution Path discovered within that segment of the body, experienced physical collapse and withdrew from this round of comprehension.

Consequently, many new talented Evolvers joined.

“Many of the Evolution Paths contained within that segment of the body are dead ends. The Supreme Beings had long set the rules that once the practice fails, one cannot continue the comprehension for a hundred years.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This was also for the good of many Evolvers. Even though they were practicing in the Virtual World, the Evolution Paths inside that segment of the body could still potentially affect them.

This was part of a Supreme Being’s body after all.

Too many attempts could affect the True Body, which could lead to serious issues.

“Our human civilization is already doing very well. For other groups without the isolation of a Virtual World, those alien strong ones who comprehend would have to risk their lives.”

“I wonder how many would die.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

So far, the Virtual World was unique to human civilization, said to originate from the methods of a Supreme Being, a product of this particular Supreme Evolution Path.

Just as Lin Yuan was about to continue his cultivation refinement.

“Gao Wufeng is looking for me?” Lin Yuan received a message.

Gao Wufeng, the most favored disciple of the Nine Swords Star Master, had engaged in conversation with Lin Yuan as soon as he entered this Virtual World, and the two had a good relationship.

Apart from Gao Wufeng, there was also Zuo Qiuguang, who had the Light Elf Bloodline.

“Gao Wufeng…” Lin Yuan felt somewhat emotional.

In these two or three years, countless Evolvers had quietly withdrawn from the chance for comprehension.

But likewise, a small number of Evolvers shone brightly, continuing on the paths of Evolution they had discovered.

Gao Wufeng was one of them.

The Evolution Path Gao Wufeng had discovered from that segment of the body was extremely special. It could even trigger the arrival of a Heart Demon.

The arrival of a Heart Demon was no small matter; it was one of the few instances that could directly affect one’s physical self in real life.

Without sufficient preparation, facing the Heart Demon and perishing in the Heart Demon Tribulation would mean not even a Supreme Being could ‘resurrect’ them.

Under normal circumstances,

the best choice for Gao Wufeng would be to decisively give up this chance for comprehension.

After all, it concerned his life.

The Supreme Evolution Path might be promising, but if one’s life were lost, what good would more Supreme Evolution Paths do?

But Gao Wufeng did not choose to give up.

Instead, he continued to refine his skills, adopting an almost maniacal attitude, welcoming the arrival of the Heart Demon.
